title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?
author: hoodmane
body_preview: Cloudflare workers supports deploying Flask applications. We have the following short guide for deploying Flask workers: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/languages/python/packages/flask/  Could we add a link to this page to the "Hosting Platforms" section of the docs?

title: remove `Response.autocorrect_location_header`
author: davidism

title: Should we remove the interactive debugger?
author: davidism
body_preview: What if we removed the interactive debugger?  - Its implementation is ridiculously complex. It's very impressive that it's possible at all. - I already had to fix it to work with Flask's contexts, and I'm not sure if we'd ever be able to get it to work with ASGI.
